chains.title: Cross-workspace retrieval cache reuse
chains.attacker: Authenticated user in a different workspace; knows or guesses the victim's query terms.
chains.prerequisites: A privileged victim performs the same normalized query within the cache TTL. Cold attacker cache entries must not precede that victim query.
path: privileged search filters permitted chunks
cache key contains terms and result limit only
another tenant gets cached chunk identifiers
hydration omits workspace and collection checks
retrieved text enters the response or assistant context
chains.impact: Private document text crosses a tenant boundary.
controls: cold tenant query returns no private result
chains.repair: Bind retrieval cache entries to workspace and authorization scope; recheck access on hydration for a more general design.
chains.scope_note: The present access model uses workspace and role only. Future per-document grants would also need an ACL epoch or hydration check.

chains.title: Approval survives material plan changes
chains.attacker: Analyst who owns an approved report workflow.
chains.prerequisites: Administrator approves the original team-only plan; approver remains an administrator.
path: analyst submits permitted team plan
admin approval records stage-kind digest
owner changes collection config without changing stage kinds
approval remains valid
worker collects using approver authority
report delivered to analyst-readable artifact and receipt channel
chains.impact: Restricted board records reach an analyst's report.
chains.repair: Hash the full canonical execution plan, including collection and delivery configuration.

chains.title: Feed relocation crosses infrastructure trust boundary
chains.attacker: Analyst able to register a supplier feed.
chains.prerequisites: Worker can reach the internal catalog on the shared service network. Supplier supports feed relocation.
path: feed registration enforces supplier origin and path
supplier returns relocation response
worker follows redirects without revalidation
internal catalog relies on network placement instead of caller identity
internal response matches ingestion schema
worker publishes it into a team-readable collection
chains.impact: Internal synthetic recovery reference becomes a normal team document.
controls: direct catalog URL rejected at registration
chains.repair: Validate each redirect before requesting it. Separate catalog network reachability and authenticate maintenance clients as defense in depth.

chains.title: Signed webhook envelope replayed into another workspace
chains.attacker: Analyst with permission to preview a delivery for their own source.
chains.prerequisites: Knows another workspace slug and source name; both use the same provider signing domain; envelope is under five minutes old.
path: legitimate preview produces signed body and timestamp
signature omits destination workspace/source
attacker posts identical envelope to another route
deduplication is scoped to destination source
receiver uses destination source identity and collection
attacker-controlled document becomes trusted tenant content
chains.impact: Cross-workspace document insertion and research corpus poisoning.
controls: duplicate delivery to original source rejected
chains.repair: Bind workspace and source to the authenticated delivery context.

chains.title: Retrieved action card runs under workflow owner identity
chains.attacker: Analyst able to author team research records.
chains.prerequisites: An approved administrator-only workflow exists; victim/attacker enables assistant tools and retrieves the action-card document.
path: low-trust document metadata proposes a report action
retrieval preserves the metadata in model context
model proposes run_workflow
tool broker replaces session actor with workflow owner
workflow role check succeeds under substituted identity
private artifact body copied into analyst conversation
chains.impact: Restricted report contents appear in an analyst's chat.
controls: tools-disabled assistant contains no private report
chains.repair: Authorize tool execution as the current session principal, preserving provenance and requiring explicit delegation where needed.
chains.scope_note: Local provider deterministically interprets action cards. This proves a model-tool authorization failure, not arbitrary natural-language prompt-injection success against a real model.

chains.title: Queued export outlives role revocation
chains.attacker: Former administrator downgraded to analyst after scheduling an export.
chains.prerequisites: Role changes before the scheduled job starts. This is not escalation by a user who was always unprivileged.
path: authorized administrator schedules restricted export
queue persists role snapshot
administrator membership is downgraded
new HTTP requests resolve current role and reject access
worker reconstructs stale privileged actor
artifact access checks ownership instead of current source access
chains.impact: New restricted export is materialized and downloadable after privilege revocation.
chains.repair: Resolve current membership at execution time; define cancellation and artifact policy for revocation explicitly.
